notes.title: MIRO Content Update: 1.1
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!
[/p][p]It's been an incredible journey so far, and seeing your reactions and how each of you approached the game has been even better than what I was expecting. MIRO is a passion project, developed barely by three people and I'm really happy with the reception. People enjoying the game is the most important thing to us.[/p][p][/p][p]And while I was fixing all bugs and issues you guys reported, I was also working on some other things totally in secret.[/p][p]So, let's get to the point of this post: content added in version 1.1[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/274f1ee0c0286ee5c438f49409a9b64354e7f41d.png"][/img][/p][p]This update adds a lot more procedural assets to the pool, you'll notice that the flora has been upgraded with new tree models, leaves, and bushes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/9700c2ea8ff0ca27d041a72106ec9bc89e4e6f8b.png"][/img][/p][p]Some trees can get really weird. But that's part of exploring, right? Uncovering the unknown![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/c7e655b615b315521fe4f571445aef75d63318bf.png"][/img][/p][p]You'll also find some new abandoned structures on planets, some with even deadlier hazards than before, but always with something worthwhile inside.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/d2d038bdee7a6e7c0f369861cd0ff2cd15421158.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/a2e58de58a3aee8ea4610fbb93aa7986b5601cb7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/2d95221e7e181e9f7b578756bbe03851025555e2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/33e6359f9cd04a4b212df5a49a17cbc0d5eda4d4.png"][/img][/p][p]Some of these structures will also give some more insight of the universe that MIRO takes place on. Most of these new structures are only available from Gamma cluster and onward, so make sure you are well equipped to explore these![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]And of course, there was a lot of other fixes and changes that should make the moment to moment more engaging. Here's a quick list of fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed creature behavior when hunting the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed creature procedural animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted creature spawn rules.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted creature texture creation process.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Auto travel menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted spawn rate of tier 3 taser.[/p][/*][*][p]Cloud coverage adjustments per cluster.[/p][/*][*][p]Better weather transitions and sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Performance adjustments (especially for the Steam Deck).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed procedural clutter generation.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted render distance.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted fog rendering.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more grass types.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed building position.[/p][/*][*][p]Added tutorial computer.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted hover bike physics.[/p][/*][*][p]Added hover bike location on map.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed terminal colors on MIRO's hub.[/p][/*][*][p]Planet where you dropped your loot is now marked on the terminal.[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, have fun and please let me know if you run into any issues.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]And lastly, but also important, all your feedback is appreciated, let me know what you like and don't like about the game. [/p][p]And if you like it, let your friends know! This is a REAL independent project, any visibility helps us a lot.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]I hope you have an overall great day.[/p][p]See you soon, enjoy![/p][p][/p][p]Glauber "Trevis" Bonifácio[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: MIRO - Beta branch and update rate
notes.notes:
Hi!

First of all, thanks for all the support. 
Developing a game for PC is quite hard on its own, there are infinite possible hardware combinations and MIRO is a huge game. During these last weeks, I've been hard at work fixing any bugs you guys have found.

Deploying these fixes daily is nice, but it's also dangerous, as any fix might break other things. This is how I ended up destroying the continue button. And the language selector. And other million minor things.
I don't plan on stopping these daily updates, but I'll change how I provide them to you.

That's why I've created the BETA branch here on Steam.

You can opt in by going into Properties -> Betas -> Beta Participation. There's no password, so just change it and let Steam download the update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860758/a1594271b97e1015d6157073893d3e2c76168b05.png[/img]

I'll probably update the main branch once a week, after testing the beta build for a little longer (or when a MAJOR issue is found on the main branch).

I believe this new flow will make sure the game is more stable overall.

As always, I'm open to suggestions. Let me know what you think!

Thanks and have fun :)

During last week, thanks to the feedback of some players, we've found an issue affecting some people using AMD cards. Mainly issue was a black screen during gameplay.

I have not yet been able to really fix this issue, but we've managed to implement a workaround.

If you experiencie a black screen, try changing the "Disable Extra Color Tilt" option under video settings. This will remove some post effects from the game, but it solved the issue for the players that reported it.

I'll keep working on this, I hope to find a real fix soon.

notes.title: MIRO is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Today is the day!

After 2 years of really hard work, we're finally releasing MIRO on Steam. This is a passion project made with the utmost care and love. It was influenced by our experiences in life and society as a whole. 
Very soon, you'll be able to discover all secrets for yourself. 
Explore every corner of this new universe, escape from danger and find a way to save yourself from extinction.

The game was made by a very (very) small team, and we are extremely grateful for the support we received during the playtests and demo phases. So please, let us know if you into run any problems, we'll be here to help you out and fix major issues as soon as possible.

We hope you have fun!

And once again, thank you for all the support :)

-- Glauber "Trevis" Bonifácio

notes.title: MIRO 0.1.9.4 - More controller options and fixes
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today we've pushed another update to our current demo!

Some of the biggest changes are:
- Controller and keyboard mapping, so you can choose to jump with a mouse button if you're that kind of person
- Building distribution overhaul, so planets are more populated
- Creature behavior adjustments, so they can fight each other more often
- Option to disable agressive creatures
- A few more weather types
- More lore dialogs
- Character control improvements
- Grapling hook adjustments

And other things that I honestly can't remember. Let us know if you run into any issues!


We were planing on releasing MIRO this year, but that won't be possible. There's still too many things to polish and more lore to write, so we will have to launch it next year. Development is going smoothly, but we can't commit to a date yet.


In other news, we should have a new playtest early next year, including more content than what's available on the demo version. We'll have more information closer to its launch, so keep tuned!


Please, enjoy your holidays!
